notes.text: Matched because the official record documents the stone figure's former display with pukao E128369 as a hat or topknot. The same record says the pukao was probably not originally made for this statue; this link does not assert an original sculptural unit. Images were retrieved from the same numbered record in the NMNH catalogue (https://collections.nmnh.si.edu/search/anth/?nb=E128368). Its image files link to Smithsonian usage terms; the Anthropology rights page permits non-commercial educational reuse with the catalogue number and institutional credit. No CC0 status, photographer identity or photograph date is inferred.
